name: Password Sign-In Locked Out
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits password credentials for an account that is currently locked out, and receives a lockout-specific outcome without establishing a session.
finalOutcome: No authenticated session is established and the user receives a lockout-specific outcome that can drive recovery or support guidance.

sourceReferences.note: PasswordSignInAsync treats SignInResult.IsLockedOut as a distinct branch and returns AuthUserLockedOut while recording PasswordAuthenticationFailed.
Scenario reconciliation assigns locked-out password submission to its own canonical outcome while reusing the shared pre-submit navigation steps.
